text: Codex now labels skill catalog sources by authority: `file`, environment, orchestrator, or custom resource. Hosted `skill://` entries point agents to `skills.list`/`skills.read`, not filesystem tools. PR: https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/27591

claims.text: Codex now renders skill catalog locators according to the skill resource authority.
Hosted `skill://` resources should be read through `skills.list` and `skills.read`, not filesystem tools.
The PR #27591 operator-impact post is live on @decodexspace.

decision.reason: The corrected catalog wording is useful to operators working with hosted skills and orchestrator resources.
